gloss: being bombed; being hit by an atomic bomb

definitions.gloss: being bombed; being hit by an atomic bomb
definitions.explanation: Suffering a bombing, above all the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki in August 1945.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広島|ひろしま}→広島：28985_hiroshima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{被爆|ひばく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother was in Hiroshima when the atomic bomb fell.

examples.japanese: {被爆者|ひばくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I listened to an atomic-bomb survivor's story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長崎|ながさき}→長崎：30731_nagasaki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広島|ひろしま}→広島：28985_hiroshima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧{被爆|ひばく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ{目|め}→二つ目：30351_futatsume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧だ。
examples.english: Nagasaki was the second city, after Hiroshima, to be hit by an atomic bomb.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {被爆者|ひばくしゃ}: atomic-bomb survivor (hibakusha)
- {被爆地|ひばくち}: a city hit by an atomic bomb
- {被爆|ひばく}⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: the experience of the atomic bombing
- {被爆|ひばく}{二世|にせい}: child of an atomic-bomb survivor

WATCH OUT:
⟦{被曝|ひばく}→被曝：22759_hibaku⟧, with the same reading, means exposure to radiation, as in a nuclear accident or a medical X-ray. A worker exposed at a nuclear plant has ⟦{被曝|ひばく}→被曝：22759_hibaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧; a survivor of Hiroshima is a {被爆者|ひばくしゃ}.
